hypothesis: Strict-prefix recorded penalty context may explain variation beyond the preserved movement inputs. This tests recorded annotation information, not active penalties, power-play age, penalty time remaining, or fatigue.
selection_history: Declared after inspecting earlier development, movement, zone, strength-partition and conditional-calibration experiments and penalty availability. This is adaptive development, not preregistration before prior inspection, an untouched test, or prospective evidence.

frozen_monotone_group.meaning: Frozen neutral original shape control retained in the conditional run; not production.

source.fast_slow_gate: Before fitting, require a complete nonpublishable verified-movement-reuse-v2 slow/fast comparison with opposite_mode_equivalent true, identical schema/config, all fold row/group/cohort hashes and ordered memberships, and bound code/runtime. Pin both proof health/report digests and comparison receipt in the create-only attempt declaration. Fast report alone is insufficient; never silently fall back to unverified rows.
integrity_gates: Strict duplicate-key/nonfinite JSON rejection, bounded streaming lines and records, exact health inventory and all source/declaration/body hashes before and after consumption.

Each vectors.jsonl record has exactly game_id,event_id,annotation; validate exact annotation and channel fields/types, version, scope, publishable false, bounded positive game and nonnegative event identities.
Require unique global game/event keys and exact entire certified development population, counts and ordered-event-key digest; reject extras, missing records, duplicate IDs or conflicting rows.

Join only by game_id,event_id; preserve original ordered row vectors, categorical fields, labels, source/feature hashes and all group/cohort memberships. Do not zip by position, approximate location, player ID or clock.
Recompute augmented schema/feature hashes separately without overwriting original hashes; content-seal augmented rows and reverify original VerifiedFeatures before and after fitting.
Retain full annotation rows and IDs as audit evidence only. No new network/DB sources or historical-as-of claims.

features.preservation: All 47 original movement numeric names and both categorical names remain in exact original order and in the fitted enhanced view, not merely retained in an audit.

append_categorical.name: recorded_penalty_same_team__annotation_state
append_categorical.rule: If status unavailable, concatenate 'unavailable:' + exact reason. If recorded_annotation, concatenate 'recorded:type_' + ('known' if recorded_type_code is not null else 'missing') + ':duration_' + ('known' if recorded_duration_minutes is not null else 'missing'). Require availability reason/value consistency; unknown status/reason is fatal, not an OTHER category.

append_categorical.name: recorded_penalty_opponent__annotation_state
append_categorical.rule: If status unavailable, concatenate 'unavailable:' + exact reason. If recorded_annotation, concatenate 'recorded:type_' + ('known' if recorded_type_code is not null else 'missing') + ':duration_' + ('known' if recorded_duration_minutes is not null else 'missing'). Require availability reason/value consistency; unknown status/reason is fatal, not an OTHER category.

features.unknown_policy: Unavailable channel requires null prior event/team/type/duration/age and each availability reason equal to channel reason. Recorded channel has positive team, nonnegative prior event, finite age, null channel reason; null type/duration has exactly its declared missing reason; observed values have null availability reasons. True zero is observed, never unknown. Null type remains categorical missing, not a invented penalty type.
features.no_feature_search: Exactly this additive family; no outcome-selected type filtering, age bins/windows, interactions, category merging, numeric transforms, missingness pruning or added identity features.

fit.raw_architecture: sklearn 1.5.2 HistGradientBoostingClassifier binary numeric-tree enhanced context, fixed original architecture
fit.preprocessing: Train split only: original development median policy, explicit numeric missing indicators, sorted training-only categorical vocabulary with distinct missing/unseen indicators. Preserve original base transform values; append only new columns. Never fit on calibration/validation or inference batches.
fit.calibration: Fit conditional_shape on this candidate's earlier calibration predictions only. Context remains prior_sog_same_team with original shot_type and strength offset fields; do not add penalty fields to calibration context or change knots/ridges/optimizer.
fit.no_search: One declared candidate per fold; no hyperparameter sweep, early stopping, fitted specialist, post-validation correction or fallback winner. Keep every failure.

resource_gate.rule: Run unchanged original preflight/vocabulary/allocation checks before each fit and inference stage, including summed original geometry/base/enhanced dense-cell bound. Chunk only inference according to existing policy. If any bound fails, preserve a resource-failure receipt; do not raise bounds, drop features/cohorts or silently merge categories. Any revised design needs a new pre-fit plan.

evaluation.membership: Exactly original fixed train/calibration/validation identities, labels and groups; no dropping unknown penalty channels or unsupported strengths.
evaluation.point_guard: For each of both folds, primary Brier <= each of both frozen mapped controls' Brier AND primary log_loss <= each control's log_loss. No averaging folds or controls; no tolerance to mask a loss increase. Failure of any comparison fails the development point guard.
evaluation.uncertainty: Retain paired whole-game fixed-fit bootstrap differences against BOTH controls using identical seeded game draws, global and original eligible subgroups, original bin edges and original support rules. Report actual intervals/valid draws. They do not account for refitting, adaptive selection or multiplicity and folds are not independent replications.
evaluation.diagnostics: All existing group dimensions unchanged, especially strength including 5v3, prior event, prior same-team SOG, shot type and unknowns. Add separately labelled diagnostic marginal groups for same-team/opponent annotation state and recorded type (None explicit); never replace original groups or select a subgroup winner. Retain all reliability bins, calibration summaries and worst deficits even if point guard passes.
evaluation.inference: Export freshly fitted model as strict JSON only; no pickle/joblib deserialization. Verify original control identity and saved prediction membership; independent JSON raw vs freshly fitted raw within 1e-12. Calibrated independent scalar vs vector atol1e-12 rtol0. Raw JSON batch/single/reversal exact; mapped atol1e-12 rtol0. Report actual maximum errors; duplicate event requests must reject under named bundle API.
evaluation.acceptance: Point guard and numerical parity are development diagnostics only. No automatic model acceptance, original-family parity, publication, production change, FPAR/GAR admission or new prospective-reservation use.

prefit_required: Independent review of new additive flattening, category consistency, immutable joins, canonical schema and all existing resource guards.

Source/boundary tests: emit-before-current-update, current goal flip, future append, side reversal, unknown penalty owner, missing replacement annotation, same-clock ordering, periods/shootouts. No outcome-dependent category construction.
Completed reuse-v2 fast/slow equivalence gate and all exact penalty source hashes. Bind new runner/feature code/tests/plan and runtime hashes in create-only run declaration before any fit.
limitations: Recorded annotation age can exceed its stated duration and remains historical, not active manpower.
This plan preserves but does not recover true legacy PP-clock semantics, continuous shifts, tracked passes/goalie motion, rink corrections, rebound creation or every original model family.
Previously inspected development supports adaptive research only; final changed pipeline still requires separately untouched/prospective validation.
No production, database, restricted dataset, frozen source or existing fitted artifact modifications.
